issue.title: Strip rich formatting from drag-and-drop into the Bob Mac Capture editor
issue.description: Approved plan plan:202608/capture_paste_plain_text.md fixed Cmd-V only. Drag-and-drop into the editor still uses AppKit native rich ingest, so browser/content drops can preserve formatting and pay the same synchronous HTML import cost. Scope: intercept text drops for the capture editor, prefer plain text with CR/LF normalization, preserve native fallthrough for non-text drops, and add macOS tests or manual verification.
